subject: general
question: Which of the following calipers are used for marking lines, parallel to inside and outside edges and for locating the centre of round bars?
solution:
The correct answer is __Leg and point calipers.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Leg and point calipers__ are used for marking lines parallel to inside and outside edges.
 
• They are also commonly used for locating the center of round bars.
 
• This tool helps in precise measurement and marking for machining and other operations.
 
• Leg and point calipers often have one leg with a pointed end for marking and another leg with a blunt end for reference.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Spring Joint Calipers:**

 
 
• These calipers are used for measuring dimensions rather than marking.
 
• They have a spring mechanism for adjustments.
 
 
 
• **Simple Calipers:**
 
 
• Simple calipers are basic tools used for measuring internal and external dimensions.
 
 
 
• **Firm Joint Calipers:**
 
 
• Firm joint calipers are used for measuring dimensions and have a firm joint for adjustment.
